_readme: Homepage copy, top to bottom. Each key feeds one section component in src/components/sections. Voice: Dr. Tau, first person, short sentences, no em dashes. Headings are uppercased by CSS, so write them in sentence case. `|` in a title forces a line break.

process.title: Four steps to | a trusted practice.

steps.title: Get found
steps.text: Fix your Google profile and listings so patients see accurate, complete information wherever they search.

steps.title: Ask every patient
steps.text: Make the review request part of checkout. Every patient, every day, without anyone having to remember.

steps.title: Respond like a pro
steps.text: Answer every review, good and bad, in a calm and professional voice. The next patient is reading.

steps.title: Train your team
steps.text: Give your team the words and the ownership. The system only works when they run it.
